sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The retained fork points into the parental duplex; new strands visibly trail behind, including a discontinuous simplified strand. Equal first IdU pulses precede two different second CldU tracks. Actual track geometry has a 2:1 second-pulse length ratio, with both 30-minute pulses and 2 kb/µm calibration printed. The toy rates are 15×2/30=1 and 7.5×2/30=0.5 kb/min. Caption, guard text and exercise separate selected molecule rate from S-phase fraction, damage, recovery, survival and checkpoint dependence. This meets the exact frozen fork-and-measurement task; the lengths remain fictional.
